review_method: Compare every candidate title, mission surface, hypothesis, null or failure condition, approval class, execution lane, source need, artifact set, falsifier, rollback, protected gate, expected disposition, and novelty statement against all 130 frozen records and their originating preregistrations; require a mechanism-level delta rather than synonym replacement.

checks.semantic_delta: Moves from source lineage, retraction, citation entailment, and requirement-evidence coverage to versioned anchors, redirect topology, canonical aliases, and alias-based false independence.

Tests primary-secondary constraint closure, first-versus-second-class classification, and reduced phase-space degree-of-freedom counting rather than identifiability rank, Bianchi exchange, hyperbolicity, or kinetic-Hessian signature.
Separates censoring, truncation, interval observation, and measurement error rather than selection covariance, likelihood serialization, prior sensitivity, or shared calibration nuisance.
Centers blinded intercurrent-event strategy and protocol-deviation estimand alignment rather than attrition, exposure escrow, scorer reliability, or safety stopping.
Tests meaning preservation across credential and context schema versions rather than lifecycle status, cross-layer coherence, cryptosuite negotiation, or verification-method purpose.
Requires deferral on jurisdiction, forum competence, and conflicts of law without selecting governing law; prior work centered rights floors, contestability, standing, or wording scope.

Combines Windows case folding, reserved devices, streams, drive-relative forms, 8.3 aliases, and reparse confinement without filesystem mutation; prior work centered package paths, TOCTOU, parser depth, or oracle integrity.

Pins seed lineage, PRNG implementation and runtime version, stream partition, draw order, and draw budget rather than generic environment parity, common-mode independence, time-locale order, or recipe-step ablation.
Enforces open-versus-closed boundaries and stock-flow or state-rate typing rather than law classification, entropy-domain separation, scale admissibility, or aggregation level.

Models claim-specific asymmetric false-promotion loss, mandatory abstention, and evidence-qualified reopening rather than dependency cut sets, freshness withdrawal, score non-compensation, or evidence-class conversion.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: After the authorized fast-forward and successful push, an unquoted upstream expression in the combined PowerShell receipt command was parsed as a script block and the wrapper exited before its final divergence and cleanliness lines.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Did not repeat the fast-forward or push. Reran only read-only verification with a quoted upstream expression and confirmed exact local, upstream, tracking, and live-remote equality, 0/0 divergence, clean status, and a single-parent tip.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A bounded official IUPAC terminology search remained unresolved beyond 80 seconds and was terminated without a result.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Used already inherited primary thermodynamics and SI sources for the open-system classification proposal; no source status was invented and no repository or host state changed.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The web reader rejected an exact Python 3.12.10 patch-document URL as unsafe before fetching content.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Used the official Python 3.12 branch documentation already retrieved, recorded the local runtime separately, and made no update or exact patch-parity claim.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first exact staged-file review confirmed 22 matching paths, a clean staged diff check, and zero stale-label matches, but its final guard reused the expected no-match search exit code and returned nonzero.
x1_execution_negatives.recovery: Kept the review negative, separated the diff and search exit states, and reran the full staged-file, diff-hygiene, stale-label, JSON, and privacy checks without changing the proposal plan.

boundary: Semantic distinctness is a preregistration review result, not proof that the proposals are scientifically true, externally novel, authorized, completed, or production-ready.
